Active: Roughly equivalent to the energy expended by a 
70 kg (154 lb) adult walking 7 miles per day at a rate of 
3 to 4 miles per hour in addition to the activities related to

Very active: Equivalent to walking 17 miles per day in ad-

Th e extra energy needed for growth during infancy, child-
hood, adolescence, and pregnancy is included in an allow-
ance referred to as “tissue deposition.” During pregnancy, the
metabolic rate is also increased due to the energy requirements 
of the uterus and fetus and the increased work of the maternal
cardiovascular system. During lactation, extra energy is needed
to support milk production, which is somewhat greater in the 
ﬁ rst six months of breastfeeding than in the second six months.
